apps.name: Inspector
apps.summary: A PDF reader that remembers your page

en-US.description:
A personal PDF manager for studying.

Inspector identifies a book by its contents rather than its filename, so renaming a
file, moving it to another folder, or reinstalling the app never separates a book from
your place in it. Your position is written whenever scrolling settles, so even a hard
kill cannot lose the page.

Shelves are built from the folders you already keep your PDFs in. Two books can be open
side by side. Margins can be cropped for scanned textbooks, night mode inverts lightness
while leaving diagrams readable, and the table of contents is one tap away.

Nothing leaves your device.
en-US.name: Inspector
en-US.summary: A PDF reader that remembers your page
en-US.whatsNew:
First release.

- Shelves built from your folders
- Resume exactly where you left off, even after a force-stop
- Two books open at once, side by side or stacked
- Bookmarks that survive renaming and moving files
- Crop margins, night mode, contents jump

apps.name: Kookie
apps.summary: Music player with its own ink

en-US.description:
Kookie is jinoy's own YouTube Music client. Built to own the player: every line auditable, every network request accounted for.

The whole network surface is one allowlist you can read in a minute — YouTube/Google endpoints only, plus GitHub for update checks and an off-by-default lyrics provider. No telemetry, no crash reporting, no third-party servers.

Ink Studio lets you pick your own ink: modes, palettes, a hue wheel and Material seeds under one roof.
en-US.name: Kookie
en-US.summary: Personal YouTube Music client — every request accounted for
en-US.whatsNew: Ink 0.8.1 — your own ink. Ink Studio: modes, palettes, hue wheel and Material seeds under one roof; instant wheel feedback; honest Dynamic swatch state.

apps.name: The Droid

en-US.description:
The Droid is jinoy's own app store, built on the F-Droid libraries with a red, futuristic identity of its own.

It browses any F-Droid-compatible repo — signed indexes, verified downloads, session installs, background update checks — and comes with The Droid Repo built in: jinoy's personal repo that delivers The Droid itself and jinoy's other custom apps as ordinary store updates.
en-US.name: The Droid
en-US.whatsNew: Your repo is home: The Droid Repo comes built in, pinned first, with a Yours shelf on Home. Existing installs pick the repo up automatically.
